description: #120 stretch 2 probe (fresh budget, attempt 2), generated by runner/test/unit/playthrough-scenarios.js from the touch layer; boots from touch-md1-1 (stretch 1's end, kept by touch-playthrough). Input: segment touch-2-stall; mark st; 600 frames with no input. End checks: field mode, md1_1. Only signs, frame counts and small state values leave.
